newsitem.title: INDIA: Festival buying drives Indian gold up.
newsitem.headline: Festival buying drives Indian gold up.

text.p: Gold prices moved up in early trade on the bullion market amid increased seasonal buying for Diwali, the approaching Hindu festival of lights, dealers said.
"Limited supplies and reports of recovery in the world market also dragged prices upward," one dealer said.
Meanwhile prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) rose by 200 rupees to 60,450 rupees per piece. They were down by 50 rupees per piece during last week.
Silver on the other hand extended gains on industrial buying and restricted supplies. Silver was up by 20 rupees per kg during last week.
